_about: The places of 冀 — the 漳水 and 邺 in the south, 太行 to the west, 发鸠 and 涿鹿 north, 碣石 at the sea. The road in comes from 徐's 泗水北岸; it opens with chapter 1.
_pools: 冀's pools: the 太行's beasts of 《山海经 · 北次三经》 (天马 of 马成之山, 领胡 of 阳山) and the 漳水's 人鱼 (决决之水) — added for 卷一, used by no later 卷 (DESIGN.md, OUTLINE.md checked 2026-10-05).

line.zh: 漳水浑黄，北去是邺城。水底有什么在呼吸。
line.en: The Zhang runs yellow; north of it lies Ye. Something under the water is breathing.

line.zh: 漳水边的城。城门贴着告示，坊市在东街。
line.en: The city on the Zhang. A notice on the gate; the market on East Street.

line.zh: 祠在水边，香灰堆得很高。年年有新娘从这里下水。
line.en: A shrine at the water's edge, ash piled high. Every year a bride walks in from here.

line.zh: 祠后的水最深，船家不肯去。鼎的气息从这里升上来。
line.en: The deepest water lies behind the shrine; no boatman will go. The cauldron's breath rises from here.

line.zh: 太行八陉之一。山那边是并州，山这边是冀。
line.en: One of the eight passes of the Taihang. Bing lies beyond the mountains; Ji on this side.

line.zh: 山上多柘木。一只花头白喙的鸟，衔着石子往东飞。
line.en: Cudrania trees cover the hill. A bird with a patterned head and white beak flies east with a pebble in its beak.

line.zh: 黄帝与蚩尤战过的地方。风里还有铜味。
line.en: Where the Yellow Emperor fought Chiyou. The wind still smells of bronze.

line.zh: 东临碣石，以观沧海。海在山下翻白。
line.en: Stand on Jieshi and look upon the sea. It turns white below the rock.

line.zh: 北岳。云在半山，庙在云里。
line.en: The Northern Peak. Clouds at the waist; a temple inside the clouds.

keeper.en: Old Hu and the Tofu Beauty

shut.zh: 门关着，门上贴着一张黄纸，盖着河伯庙的红印：这一家，河伯定了。
shut.en: The door is shut, a yellow paper on it under the River Lord temple's red seal: this house, the River Lord has chosen.

line.zh: 城西一条窄街，豆浆的气味。门框上拿炭划着道，一天划掉一道。
line.en: A narrow street on the west side, and the smell of soy milk. Charcoal strokes on the door frame, one crossed out each day.

line.zh: 河伯庙的嫁衣，二十五年，一年一身，都是这家的活。一身八百文，三老付钱，从来不还价。
line.en: Twenty-five years of brides' dresses for the River Lord's temple, one a year, all made here. Eight hundred cash each; the Three Elders paid and never haggled.

line.zh: 香烛鼓乐，三老一年统共给三贯。柜上摆着几样开过光的玉。
line.en: Incense, drums and pipes: three strings a year from the Three Elders, all told. A few blessed jades lie on the counter.

name.en: Ye · the inn on the east side

line.zh: 掌柜是个胖子，面汤清得照得见人影。后院有一口井，井台上坐得下一个人算账。
line.en: The innkeeper is stout, the noodle soup clear enough to see your face in. A well in the back yard, its rim wide enough for one person doing sums.

line.zh: 城北一座三进的大宅子。漳水那天以后，箱子都抬空了，门也没人守。
line.en: A great house of three courtyards on the north side. Since the day of the Zhang its chests stand empty, and no one keeps the gate.

line.zh: 漳水下游的渔村，岸上一排老柳。二十五年，谁也不敢往下游看一眼。
line.en: A fishing village downstream on the Zhang, a row of old willows on the bank. For twenty-five years no one dared look downstream.
